原: As you’ll see, however, the approach to mastering.
疑为: As you’ll see, however, the approach to mastering many areas of life is somewhat counterintuitive.
理由: 一句话在 mastering 后被句号切断，133 与 134 本是一句；翻译按整句意思分两半译

原: Many areas of life is somewhat counterintuitive.
疑为: （接上句）many areas of life is somewhat counterintuitive.
理由: 同上，是 133 的后半句，不是独立句

原: …or at least it hasn’t been for a few billion.
疑为: …or at least it hasn’t been for a few billion years.
理由: 句号切在 billion 和 years 之间，years 被分到下一句；162 按“几十亿年”译

原: years, if Pluto’s atmosphere is very different…
疑为: If Pluto’s atmosphere is very different…
理由: 开头的 years 属于上一句；翻译从 If 起译

原: …not direct observations of the hazes composition.
疑为: …not direct observations of the haze’s composition.
理由: 所有格撇号缺失，应为 haze’s

原: Children have an openness to new music, … of their kids,” he said.
疑为: “Children have an openness to new music, … of their kids,” he said.
理由: 有右引号无左引号，句首缺左引号
与 176、187 的 Egermann 拼法不一致，同一人；译作埃格曼
Hauke 的转写错误（同音），与 176 不一致；192 同；译作豪克·埃格曼

原: …showed a stronger link between passion and achievement, the effect of passion on performance was more subtle…
疑为: …showed a stronger link between passion and achievement, whereas the effect of passion on performance was more subtle…
理由: 两个分句只用逗号连接（逗号拼接），按对比关系译作“而……”
